NVJPEG_BACKEND_GPU_HYBRID.doc: Uses GPU for Huffman decoding. `nvjpegDecodeBatched` will use GPU decoding for baseline JPEG images with interleaved scan when batch size is greater than 50. The [Decode API—Decoupled Decoding](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/nvjpeg/index.html#nvjpeg-decoupled-decode-api) will use GPU assisted Huffman decoding.

NVJPEG_BACKEND_GPU_HYBRID_DEVICE.doc: Supports input bitstream on device memory. Can be used only with batched decode APIs for baseline JPEG images without restart intervals.

NVJPEG_BACKEND_HARDWARE.doc: Uses [Hardware Acceleration](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/nvjpeg/index.html#nvjpeg-hardware-accelaration) for decode. Supports baseline JPEG images with single scan with 1 or 3 channels. 410 and 411 chroma subsamplings are not supported.

NVJPEG_BACKEND_HARDWARE_DEVICE.doc: Supports input bitstream on device memory. Can be used only with batched decode APIs. Uses [Hardware Acceleration](https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/archive/13.4.2/nvjpeg/index.html#nvjpeg-hardware-accelaration) for decode. Supports baseline JPEG images with single scan with 1 or 3 channels. 410 and 411 chroma subsamplings are not supported.

NVJPEG_BACKEND_LOSSLESS_JPEG.doc: Supports lossless jpeg bitstreams as defined in the jpeg 92 standard. Bitstreams with up to 2 channels and prediction mode 1 are supported.

NVJPEG_ENCODING_BASELINE_DCT.doc: Corresponds to the JPEG marker 0xc0, refer to the JPEG spec for more details.

NVJPEG_ENCODING_EXTENDED_SEQUENTIAL_DCT_.doc: Corresponds to the JPEG marker 0xc1, refer to the JPEG spec for more details.

NVJPEG_ENCODING_LOSSLESS_HUFFMAN.doc: Corresponds to the JPEG marker 0xc3, refer to the JPEG spec for more details.

NVJPEG_ENCODING_PROGRESSIVE_DCT_HUFFMAN.doc: Corresponds to the JPEG marker 0xc2, refer to the JPEG spec for more details.

NVJPEG_ENCODING_UNKNOWN.doc: This value is returned for all the JPEG markers not supported by the nvJPEG library.

NVJPEG_ENC_BACKEND_DEFAULT.doc: Use hardware engine if possible. If not, fallback to CUDA encoder.

NVJPEG_ENC_BACKEND_HARDWARE.doc: Always use hardware engine. Do not fallback to CUDA.

NVJPEG_INPUT_BGR.doc: Input image is in RGB color model. Pixel format is planar BGR.

NVJPEG_INPUT_BGRI.doc: Input image is in RGB color model. Pixel format is interleaved BGR.

NVJPEG_INPUT_NV12.doc: Input image is in YUV color model. Pixel format is NV12 with separated Y and interleaved UV.

NVJPEG_INPUT_RGB.doc: Input image is in RGB color model. Pixel format is planar RGB.

NVJPEG_INPUT_RGBI.doc: Input image is in RGB color model. Pixel format is interleaved RGB.

NVJPEG_INPUT_YUV.doc: Input image is in YUV color model. Pixel format is planar YUV.

NVJPEG_ORIENTATION_FLIP_HORIZONTAL.doc: Decoded output should be mirrored/flipped horizontally.

NVJPEG_ORIENTATION_FLIP_VERTICAL.doc: Decoded output should be mirrored/flipped vertically.

NVJPEG_ORIENTATION_ROTATE_180.doc: Decoded output should be rotated 180 degrees.

NVJPEG_ORIENTATION_ROTATE_270.doc: Decoded output should be rotated 270 degrees counter-clockwise.

NVJPEG_ORIENTATION_ROTATE_90.doc: Decoded output should be rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise.

NVJPEG_ORIENTATION_TRANSPOSE.doc: Decoded output should be flipped/mirrored horizontally followed by a 90 degrees counter-clockwise rotation.

NVJPEG_ORIENTATION_TRANSVERSE.doc: Decoded output should be flipped/mirrored horizontally followed by a 270 degrees counter-clockwise rotation.

NVJPEG_ORIENTATION_UNKNOWN.doc: Exif orientation information is not available in the bitstream.

NVJPEG_OUTPUT_NV12.doc: Return in the NV12 format (separate Y and interleaved UV). **Requires chroma subsampling 4:2:0.**

NVJPEG_OUTPUT_UNCHANGED.doc: Return the decoded image planar format.

NVJPEG_OUTPUT_UNCHANGEDI.doc: Return the decoded image in uint8 interleaved format.

NVJPEG_OUTPUT_UNCHANGEDI_U16.doc: Return the decoded image in uint16 interleaved format.

NVJPEG_OUTPUT_YUV.doc: Return in the YUV planar format.

NVJPEG_OUTPUT_YUY2.doc: Return in the YUY2 format (interleaved YUYV). **Requires chroma subsampling is 4:2:2.**

NVJPEG_SCALE_1_BY_2.doc: Decoded output width and height are scaled by a factor of 1/2.

NVJPEG_SCALE_1_BY_4.doc: Decoded output width and height are scaled by a factor of 1/4.

NVJPEG_SCALE_1_BY_8.doc: Decoded output width and height are scaled by a factor of 1/8.

NVJPEG_STATUS_ALLOCATOR_FAILURE.doc: The user-provided allocator functions, for either memory allocation or for releasing the memory, returned a non-zero code.

NVJPEG_STATUS_ARCH_MISMATCH.doc: The device capabilities are not enough for the set of input parameters provided (input parameters such as backend, encoded stream parameters, output format).

NVJPEG_STATUS_BAD_JPEG.doc: Cannot parse the JPEG stream. Check that the encoded JPEG stream and its size parameters are correct.

NVJPEG_STATUS_EXECUTION_FAILED.doc: Error during the execution of the device tasks.

NVJPEG_STATUS_INTERNAL_ERROR.doc: Error during the execution of the device tasks.

NVJPEG_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER.doc: Wrong parameter was passed. For example, a null pointer as input data, or an image index not in the allowed range.

NVJPEG_STATUS_JPEG_NOT_SUPPORTED.doc: Attempting to decode a JPEG stream that is not supported by the nvJPEG library.

NVJPEG_STATUS_NOT_INITIALIZED.doc: The library handle was not initialized. A call to `nvjpegCreate()` is required to initialize the handle.

NVJPEG_STATUS_SUCCESS.doc: The API call has finished successfully. Note that many of the calls are asynchronous and some of the errors may be seen only after synchronization.

chroma_subsampling.doc: Chroma subsampling that will be used for JPEG compression. If the input is in YUV color model and `chroma_subsampling` is different from the subsampling factors of source image, then the NVJPEG library will convert subsampling to the value of `chroma_subsampling`. Default value is 4:4:4.

encode_params.doc: Encoder parameters that will be used for compression.

encoder_params.doc: Pointer to the location where the new parameters structure will be placed.

encoder_state.doc: Pointer to the encoder state structure, where the new state will be placed.

input_format.doc: Value of `nvjpegInputFormat_t` type that describes the input data.

input_subsampling.doc: Value of `nvjpegChromaSubsampling_t` type that describes the input data. Ignored for non-YUV input formats.

restart_interval.doc: Restart interval that will be used for JPEG compression. Default value is 0 (no restart markers).
